newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 17.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Media rivals Rupert Murdoch and Kerry Packer settled all legal claims between their business interests on Thursday, heading off what promised to be a bitter court battle over film and television rights. Murdoch's News Corp and Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd also announced that Packer's Channel Nine had won the free-to-air broadcast rights for Monday night Super League matches.

Gold production at the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea in the second half of 1996 was 464,068 ounces, below the 500,000 ounce target set by the joint venture in mid-1996, Placer Pacific Ltd said on Friday. Placer's parent Placer Dome Inc also said late on Thursday it now held more than 50 percent of takeover target Highlands Gold Ltd. The A$0.75 a share offer is due to close on January 18.

Grand Hotel Group said on Monday that its 1996/97 result was likely to be below the prospectus forecast if current trends continued. The company, which listed on August 12 and operates the Grand Hyatt Melbourne and the Hyatt Regency Perth, also said its results in the final five months of calendar 1996 were likely to be in line with the prospectus.
